properties.name: stripe.secret-key
properties.description: Stripe secret API key (sk_live_... o sk_test_...). Vacío = modo MOCK.

properties.name: stripe.webhook-secret
properties.description: Stripe webhook signing secret (whsec_...) para verificar firmas de eventos.

properties.name: stripe.price-id.pro
properties.description: Stripe Price ID del plan PRO mensual (price_...).

properties.name: stripe.price-id.enterprise
properties.description: Stripe Price ID del plan ENTERPRISE mensual (price_...).

properties.name: anthropic.api-key
properties.description: Anthropic Claude API key (sk-ant-...). Vacío = AI Copilot deshabilitado.

properties.name: anthropic.model
properties.description: Claude model ID a usar en el copilot. Default: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.

properties.name: whatsapp.phone-id
properties.description: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API — Phone Number ID. Vacío = modo SIMULADO (sin envío real).

properties.name: whatsapp.token
properties.description: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API — Access Token permanente. Vacío = modo SIMULADO.

properties.name: internal.secret
properties.description: Secret requerido en header X-Internal-Secret para endpoints server-only (reset-datos, etc.). Configurar como variable de entorno INTERNAL_SECRET. Si está vacío, los endpoints protegidos quedan bloqueados.
